title: Player shows name byline and theme tokens
description:
## Behavior
```gherkin
Feature: Embed player
  Scenario: Renders clip metadata
    Given a job with name and byline
    When the player mounts
    Then name and byline are visible
  Scenario: Theme via CSS variables
    Given host CSS sets --auritus-accent and --auritus-font
    When the player mounts
    Then the player uses those tokens
```

## Implementation brief
1. embed/src/player — shadow DOM, poll GET /jobs/{hash}, CSS vars.
2. Drop-in src/index.ts with data-auritus-site-key/name/byline.
right_now_summary: The player is being built to show clip metadata and use host CSS theme tokens.
